hero.title: Aman × Navier — Sveti Stefan & the Bay of Kotor, by foil
hero.subtitle: A private islet and a fjord, linked in silence across the Adriatic.
hero.what_we_do_together: We bring a foiling-electric arrival and coastal tier to Aman Sveti Stefan and the Bay of Kotor — Tivat airport and the bay's villages linked by silent foils, and Adriatic runs down the Montenegrin and Croatian coast. Navier supplies the fleet; Aman brings the guests and the setting.

partner_context.their_ambition: Aman places guests in the world's most extraordinary settings; Sveti Stefan, a whole private islet, sits on one of the Mediterranean's most dramatic coasts.
partner_context.their_pressure: That coast is served by a single congested road, at odds with the serenity of the islet.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: Navier makes the bay the corridor — silent, zero-wake arrivals and an Adriatic tier worthy of the setting.

markets.why_now: Montenegro's coast is booming as a luxury-yachting destination (Porto Montenegro, Portonovi) while its single coastal road gridlocks. The EU and the Adriatic are tightening marine emissions. A silent foiling tier is the arrival Aman Sveti Stefan's islet setting calls for.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop - roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster (30+ kt cruise), and dramatically smoother and quieter. It's software-defined and autonomy-ready, so the same fleet keeps getting better and cheaper to run over time. A step-change in marine mobility, not an incremental faster boat.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: Navier rides on infrastructure that already exists - the open ocean and the berths and jetties already in use. No vertiports, no new rights-of-way, no tunnels or tracks. Pioneer II needs only a berth pedestal; the Quanta-LR hybrid needs no charging infrastructure at all. That's the fundamental contrast with flying taxis and other new-infrastructure modes: nothing to permit, build, or wait for.
why_navier_now.the_moment: The Bay of Kotor is one of the Mediterranean's most dramatic seascapes, but its coastal road is slow and crowded. Foiling makes the bay itself the corridor — a silent arrival to a private islet and an effortless run down a booming yachting coast.
